title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is sensitive to the variance in the data. When more data points are added, the variance structure can change, potentially altering the principal components.

title: Singular Values and Variance
text: The singular values in PCA represent the amount of variance captured by each principal component. Larger singular values indicate more variance captured.

title: Effect of Adding Data Points
text: Consider how adding more data points might affect the variance in the dataset. Would the principal components remain the same?
